item.title: 001: Contiguous Memory
item.description: 001: Contiguous Memory Motivation Default behaviors, both in systems as well as in people, are incredibly important. The data structures we use day in and day out have a huge impact on performance. While things like asymptotic complexity do have value, I believe the current calculus employed by the average programmer is a bit skewed in the wrong direction. Particularly, I think they are considering things like asymptotic complexity before considering the memory layout of a particular data structure.
